description_en: Retrieves the details of a message route in an edge instance
description_zh: 调用该接口，获取边缘实例中消息路由的详细信息
name: GetEdgeInstanceMessageRouting

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the IoT Platform instance.
Enterprise Enterprise instance: You must specify this parameter. You can view instance ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console (http://iot.console.aliyun.com/).
Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
物联网平台的实例ID：
企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台 (http://iot.console.aliyun.com/)的实例概览页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by moving the pointer over the name of the target edge instance on the Edge Instances page in the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)
parameters.help_zh: 边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message route. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212633.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 消息路由ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212633.html接口获取
parameters.name: route_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.
Success: The call was successful.
Other values: An error occurred. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the message route was created

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the message route was created
GmtCreateTimestamp.description_zh: 创建消息路由的Unix时间戳

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the message route was last updated
GmtModified.description_zh: 最后一次更新消息路由的时间

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the message route was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新消息路由的Unix时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the message route

RouteContext.description_en: The supplementary information about the message source and the message receiver
RouteContext.description_zh: 消息来源和消息接收者的补充信息

Qos.description_en:
The quality of service (QoS) level. Valid values:

0: The message is sent only once, regardless of whether it is successfully received by the message receiver.

1: The message is sent at least once until an acknowledgment is received from the message receiver
Qos.description_zh:
服务级别：

0：表示消息仅发送一次，不管是否被消息接收者成功接收。

1：表示最少发送一次消息，直至收到消息接收者的返回信息，则停止发送该消息

SourceApplicationName.description_en: The name of the Function Compute edge application. This parameter is returned if SourceType is function and the edge application specified in SourceData is a Function Compute edge application
SourceApplicationName.description_zh: SourceType为function，且SourceData中指定的边缘应用，是函数计算类型的边缘应用时，返回此参数，表示函数计算类型边缘应用的名称

SourceFcFunctionName.description_en: The name of the function in the Function Compute edge application. This parameter is returned if SourceType is function and the edge application specified in SourceData is a Function Compute edge application
SourceFcFunctionName.description_zh: SourceType为function，且SourceData中指定的边缘应用，是函数计算类型的边缘应用时，返回此参数，表示函数计算类型边缘应用中的函数名称

SourceFcServiceName.description_en: The service name of the Function Compute edge application. This parameter is returned if SourceType is function and the edge application specified in SourceData is a Function Compute edge application
SourceFcServiceName.description_zh: SourceType为function，且SourceData中指定的边缘应用，是函数计算类型的边缘应用时，返回此参数，表示函数计算类型边缘应用中的服务名称

TargetApplicationName.description_en: The name of the Function Compute edge application. This parameter is returned if TargetType is function and the edge application specified in TargetData is a Function Compute edge application
TargetApplicationName.description_zh: TargetType为function，且TargetData中指定的边缘应用，是函数计算类型的边缘应用时，返回此参数，表示函数计算类型边缘应用的名称

TargetFcFunctionName.description_en: The name of the function in the Function Compute edge application. This parameter is returned if TargetType is function and the edge application specified in TargetData is a Function Compute edge application
TargetFcFunctionName.description_zh: TargetType为function，且TargetData中指定的边缘应用，是函数计算类型的边缘应用时，返回此参数，表示函数计算类型边缘应用中的函数名称

TargetFcServiceName.description_en: The name of the function in the Function Compute edge application. This parameter is returned if TargetType is function and the edge application specified in TargetData is a Function Compute edge application
TargetFcServiceName.description_zh: TargetType为function，且TargetData中指定的边缘应用，是函数计算类型的边缘应用时，返回此参数，表示函数计算类型边缘应用中的函数名称

SourceData.description_en:
The data of the message source.

If SourceType is device:

    - The value format is `/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`, which indicates that the message source is a specific device under a specific product.

{Your_ProductKey} and {Your_DeviceName} are the ProductKey and DeviceName of your actual device.

    - The value format is `/{Your_ProductKey}/+`, which indicates that the message source is all devices under a specific product.

{Your_ProductKey} is the ProductKey of your actual device.

    - The value is #, which indicates that the message source is all devices under all products in the edge instance.

If SourceType is function, this parameter indicates the ID of the edge application.

If SourceType is IotHub, this parameter is empty
SourceData.description_zh:
消息来源的数据：

SourceType为device时：

    - 此处参数值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`：表示消息来源为指定产品下的指定设备。

{Your_ProductKey}和{Your_DeviceName}是您实际设备的ProductKey和DeviceName。

    - 此处参数值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/+`：表示消息来源为指定产品下的所有设备。

{Your_ProductKey}是您实际设备的ProductKey。

    - 此处参数值为#：表示消息来源为边缘实例中所有产品下的所有设备。

SourceType为function时：此处是边缘应用的ID。

SourceType为IotHub时：此处为空

SourceType.description_en:
The message source. Valid values:
device: The message is sent by a device.
function: The message is sent by an edge application.
IotHub: The message is sent from the cloud
SourceType.description_zh:
消息来源：
device：表示消息由设备发出。
function：表示消息由边缘应用发出。
IotHub：表示消息由云端发出

TargetData.description_en:
The data of the message receiver.
If TargetType is function, this parameter indicates the ID of the edge application.
If TargetType is IotHub, this parameter is empty
TargetData.description_zh:
消息接收者的数据：
TargetType为function时：此处是边缘应用的ID。
TargetType为IotHub时：此处为空

TargetType.description_en:
The message receiver. Valid values:
function: The message is sent to an edge application.
IotHub: The message is sent to the cloud
TargetType.description_zh:
消息接收者：
function：表示消息发送给边缘应用。
IotHub：表示消息发送给云端

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
